d: Mumbai Police has issued Look Out Circulars (LOCs) against three leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) — Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The action is linked to an FIR registered after CJP's October 2 protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park, where party members demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
